title: JPMorgan hikes 2026 S&P 500 target, but sees hurdles ahead for stocks - CNBC TV18
text: Stocks JPMorgan hikes 2026 S&P 500 target, but sees hurdles ahead for stocks Stocks will keep going higher — just not in a straight line, according to JPMorgan. By: Fred Imbert June 24, 2026 | 19:30 IST Twitter Whatsapp Facebook LinkedIn Copy Link Stocks will keep going higher — just not in a straight line, according to JPMorgan. Strategist Dubravko Lakos-Bujas raised his year-end S&P 500 target to 7,800 from 7,200. The new forecast implies upside of 5.9%.
